stage_8_mock_committee.interrogation_question: The Committee notes your reliance on the DMRC Metro Viaduct Package 3 (₹39.50 Cr) as primary evidence of technical capability. However, the tender scope explicitly demands 'Pre-Stressed Concrete (PSC)' construction for a 4-lane elevated flyover, whereas your cited experience pertains to 'RCC piers' and general viaducts. Metro viaducts typically utilize post-tensioned or precast segments with distinct structural loads and detailing compared to the cast-in-situ PSC girders required for this Outer Ring Road project. Furthermore, your audited turnover of ₹28.50 Cr in FY 2024-25 is significantly lower than the value of the cited experience (₹39.50 Cr), raising questions about the financial sustainability and current operational capacity to mobilize resources for a project of this magnitude without additional financial guarantees. You are hereby directed to clarify: (1) Provide specific structural drawings and completion certificates proving that the DMRC work involved Pre-Stressed Concrete elements, not merely RCC; and (2) Submit a detailed financial solvency certificate and bank guarantee proposal demonstrating your ability to fund the initial mobilization advance, given that your annual turnover is less than the value of your largest cited project.
stage_8_mock_committee.remediation: 1. Submit a notarized affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (₹500) explicitly detailing the percentage of Pre-Stressed Concrete work executed in the DMRC Package 3, accompanied by structural drawings and material test reports for PSC tendons and ducts. 2. Provide a fresh Bank Guarantee (BG) for 10% of the estimated contract value (or as per tender terms) to be issued by a Nationalized Bank, along with a certified copy of the latest (FY 2024-25) audited balance sheet and profit & loss account, clearly highlighting the net worth and current assets to prove financial solvency independent of the cited project value.
